notes.title: Alpha 3.3 Additions and changes
notes.notes:
Good evening all,

First and foremost, have a lovely weekend! If you're still working this weekend, hang in there, you'll have off pretty soon! Prior to starting mine, a little patch and some updates:

- Fixed an issue with the character selection menu, at times the primary and secondary weapon default values would appear instead of allocated names per weapon class.

- Nerfed weapon damages across the board for gameplay balance.

- 8 different Vigon faction aliens have been added with their own attribute (speed, hp, damage, etc) pool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/f023b98bb1798b7e55054399a7f08df0ff80f31f.png

- Added a Vigon alien model in the main menu's background.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/64e6032928e9c382695751c4d76aa34e9081162e.jpg

- Conversion from Unreal Engine blueprint solution to C++ solution has commenced.

- First version of the dedicated server has been compiled and tested. Thus far great results.

- Console has now been enabled.

notes.title: Alpha 3.2 Additions and changes
notes.notes:
Good evening,


- Added body awareness by introducing FPS legs in the first person camera for all characters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/d24fa62580365c8ace089d92a815af9437d772dc.jpg

- Vigon (npc) faction has been added.

- Vigon (npc) has received its own animations and sound fx.

- Horde mode 'base' game mode is under construction and will be used to fight against the Vigon faction. Will inform more about this mode as soon as it's ready!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/6fbc13580d68d514890dea7d779a4fb8b7accd0f.jpg

- Deathmatch game mode is under construction and will be made available soon.

- Added the 'invite only' checkmark to the create game menu. This implies you can only play with people you invite 'online', thus disabling the LAN functionality. Setting the server to invite only implies you simply don't want it to be listed in the server list but still joinable by steam invite/IP sharing. If switched off, the LAN functionality will be active once again. The same behavior is replicated whenever LAN checkbox is marked. However differs from a network point of view.

- Bots being enabled by default (when creating a match) is no longer a thing. You will have to enable them upon creating a match, after all, the core of Renegade is to engage into PVP. While the bots generate better content than the players do at this very time. They won't do you much good aside from getting acquainted to the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/4ba0eb252b8584e9737acbc50b63c17b8c202472.jpg

- Partial controller support has been enabled in-game. In terms of UI navigation, for the moment, you must use mouse and keyboard.

- Backups of the old Renegade alpha build (2.0) are no longer being made, since we're a month and another alpha release further, the HDD space can be spared and dedicated to the alpha 3.0 build.

Kind regards,

Cet

notes.title: Alpha 3.1 additions and changes
notes.notes:
Afternoon,

- Added footsteps fx for Renegade faction.
- Added jump fx for both Mercenary and Renegade factions.
- Added pain fx for both Mercenary and Renegade factions.
- Added Mercenary faction AI bot model.
- Added blood effects whenever hit for the Mercenary faction.
- Added metal effects whenever hit for the Renegade faction.
- Added taunt sounds for both Mercenary and Renegade faction.

- Removed weapons load-out being able to be picked up for both Mercenary and Renegade faction. While there are enough ways of obtaining ammo for both factions, it proves to be the least beneficial to have load-outs drop as a separate pickup. In the future, the load-out of the defeated opponent/ally will simply drop ammo matching your chosen faction.

- Renegade bots currently use the Mercenary faction weapons.  Once the Renegade faction its arsenal is complete, the faction will only be able to use their own weapons.

- Buffed Renegade Enforcer HP to 250 HP.
- Nerfed Renegade Enforcer capability to sprint (in other words, it can't sprint).
- Buffed Mercenary McCain HP to 150.

Kind regards,

Cet

notes.title: Alpha 2.1: Lab map release
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Happy to inform that the map ‘Lab’ has been released today. The map will be featured in Face off and Team brawl. Of course you can play this map against bots via the single player mode too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38763595/25d7dab97e7399793cca9ba1a8b1429b473fa025.png

This map is a bit more different than usual since I've put it together myself using prefabs and Dungeon Architect. Unlike KOTH this map has a bit more thought put into it. KOTH was the first map I've ever put together in Unreal Engine. It was also the very first thing I put together and it shows!

Based on review feedback, I've adjusted the way I seeded spawn points. Let me know if these points work out better than the previous maps. If so? I will seed the points the same way as I've done for this map in all other maps.

Additionally I've been doing some other things .Mostly code stuff;

- Added upcoming functionality for the in game admin panel.

- Preparations for the coop modes have started.

- Fixed a slight misplacement issue of the Renegade hud

- Fixed the into to show Epic's Unreal Engine logo once again.

Kind regards,

Cet
